verdict.rationale: Perplexity's docs say Computer accepts file uploads up to 200 MB and can 'Process CSV, JSON, Excel, PDF, images, audio, and video files'. Analysis runs in a sandboxed Linux VM with Python and a persistent file workspace, so the core of the story (upload spreadsheets and PDFs and analyze them) is documented first-party. Missing for 10: hands-on or independent evidence that the analysis is accurate, explicit coverage of word-processor documents (e.g., DOCX), and in-depth docs on file-analysis workflows beyond a one-line feature list.
